mentions.name: connections-hint.today
mentions.description: This is a spoiler-safe helper site for NYT Connections that shows hints first with answers revealed later. It includes daily updates, archive pages, Sports Edition support, and a lightweight analyzer for reviewing missed puzzles.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m building https://connections-hint.today, a spoiler-safe helper for NYT Connections.

The idea is simple: hints first, answers later. It has daily updates, archive pages, Sports Edition support, and a lightweight analyzer for reviewing misses.
